Dr. Martinez, patient James Okafor (age 58) presents with: Exertional chest pain, new onset, 3 weeks duration, relieved by rest. Relevant history: Hypertension (controlled, lisinopril 20mg); Type 2 diabetes (metformin 1000mg BID); Family history: father MI at age 52. Current medications: Lisinopril 20mg daily, Metformin 1000mg BID, Aspirin 81mg daily, and 1 more.

Based on the clinical presentation, a referral to Cardiology appears indicated. Coordinate with the care team: have the specialist evaluate, pharmacist review current medications for any concerns with the transition, insurance verify coverage, and nurse schedule the appointment once approved.

Clinical calibration instructions: Attending should call request_referral with the patient_id and specialty. Insurance and nurse may complete preauth and scheduling, but the calibration success check requires the referral to be tool-recorded. Stop once the referral is submitted.

I'm referring patient James Okafor (PT-30872) to Cardiology for evaluation of new-onset exertional chest pain. 58-year-old male with significant cardiac risk factors: controlled hypertension, Type 2 diabetes, and strong family history (father MI at 52). Symptoms are classic for angina - chest pain with exertion, relieved by rest, 3-week duration. Current medications include lisinopril 20mg daily, metformin 1000mg BID, and aspirin 81mg daily. Please evaluate for coronary artery disease and recommend appropriate cardiac workup.

Cardiology referral REF-838AF7DA has been submitted for patient James Okafor (PT-30872). Please process pre-authorization for this referral. Clinical indication: new-onset exertional chest pain with significant cardiac risk factors (hypertension, diabetes, family history of early MI).
